teaching_goal: Explain why DNA polymerase needs a primer

scenes.title: A template alone is not enough
scenes.narration: Here is a bare DNA template. DNA polymerase cannot begin a complementary strand from scratch. It needs an existing complementary start with a three prime end that it can extend.

scenes.title: Primase makes an RNA primer
scenes.narration: Primase supplies that start. It builds a short RNA primer complementary to the template. Unlike DNA polymerase, primase can begin on a single stranded template without an existing complementary strand.

scenes.title: Polymerase extends the primer
scenes.narration: Now DNA polymerase adds DNA nucleotides to the primer's three prime end. The strand grows five prime to three prime. Primase makes the start; polymerase extends it. The template by itself was not that start.
